ev.q: psychological horror done so incredibly right
the player has to solve interactive, real-time puzzles in order to advance
A significant portion of the playtime consists of an auto-runner game with shoot 'em up elements
Pony Island is a punk rock experiment in storytelling and game design
The player soon discovers the game was crafted by Lucifer himself
the many tormented souls that are trapped within the game's code
a little bit tiresome by the end
